uncertain.text: ἡλικία, ἡ ο. ἀκμὴ τῆς ἡλικίας, ἡ
uncertain.note: Spacing material shows as ink between the words around ἀκμὴ τῆς. I read the letters as ἀκμὴ τῆς ἡλικίας. There is also a stray mark after ἡλικία.
The broken mark after ὁ could be a comma or a period. I took it as a comma.
The marks after κόλασις and καταστροφή are small. I read both as commas.
I read the marks after the headword and after παχύς as periods, not commas.
